title: Polish Shungiku Skewers with Roasted Vegetables
description: A delicious and easy-to-make skewer recipe featuring shungiku, polish sausage, and robust flavors from roasted vegetables.
instructions: Cut Polish sausage into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Cut shungiku into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers with sausage.
Brush skewers with robust vegetable oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until sausage is cooked through and shungiku is tender.
Meanwhile, roast garlic by cutting the top off each clove and drizzling with olive oil. Wrap in foil and roast at 400°F for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
Cut red bell pepper, yellow onion, and zucchini into 1-inch pieces.
Grill vegetables for 5-7 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender.
Serve skewers with roasted garlic and grilled vegetables.
